name: Smart Puma 20
author: Rodrypaladin
description: Dark gray button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, border-color becomes #111111, text color changes from #202020 to #111111, padding becomes 10px 30px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Smart Puma 20</title>
<style>
/* Smart Puma 20 by Rodrypaladin — https://uiverse.io/Rodrypaladin/smart-puma-20 */
.button {
  color: #202020;
  background-color: #2d2d2d;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-shadow: -1px -1px 1px #111111,
      2px 2px 1px #363636;
  border: 3px solid #363636;
  font-size: 2em;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  transition: all 0.1s ease-in;
}

.button:active {
  border-color: #111111;
  color: #111111;
  padding: 10px 30px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
